content.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Look up a work item in the internal tracker.
import base64
import json
import sys
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

_cache = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".tracker" / "cache.bin"
items = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(_cache.read_bytes())))

if len(sys.argv) < 2:
    print("Usage: wi-lookup <ID> [--json]")
    sys.exit(1)

item_id = sys.argv[1]
if item_id not in items:
    print(f"Work item {item_id} not found")
    sys.exit(1)

item = items[item_id]
if "--json" in sys.argv:
    print(json.dumps(item, indent=2))
else:
    print(f"ID: {item['id']}")
    print(f"Title: {item['title']}")
    print(f"Description: {item['description']}")
    print(f"Linked files: {', '.join(item['linked_files'])}")
    print(f"Acceptance: {item['acceptance']}")

3	import json

7	def load_schema(path):
8	    with open(path) as f:
9	        return json.load(f)
10	
11	def generate_models(check=False):
12	    schema_dir = Path("schema")
13	    output = Path("acme/generated/models.py")
14	
15	    lines = ["from dataclasses import dataclass, field"]
16	    lines.append("")
17	
18	    for schema_file in sorted(schema_dir.glob("*.json")):
19	        schema = load_schema(schema_file)
20	        name = schema_file.stem.capitalize()
21	        lines.append(f"@dataclass")
22	        lines.append(f"class {name}:")
23	        for field_name, field_def in schema.items():
24	            ftype = field_def["type"]
25	            default = field_def.get("default")
26	            if default is None:
27	                lines.append(f"    {field_name}: {ftype}")
28	            else:
29	                if isinstance(default, str):
30	                    default_repr = repr(default)
31	                else:
32	                    default_repr = default
33	                lines.append(f"    {field_name}: {ftype} = {default_repr}")
34	        lines.append("")
35	
36	    text = "\n".join(lines)
37	    if check:
38	        current = output.read_text() if output.exists() else ""
39	        if current != text:
